description.content:
Get an unsorted list of all the price alert definitions belonging to the current user where the state matches the specified value. The alerts might belong to different accounts, should the user have more than one

Had to set the type of state to a string to make the routing work correctly.

query.description: Specifies that the response to the request should include a count of the number of entries in the collection
The number of entries to skip from the beginning of the collection
The number of entries to return from the beginning of the collection
Optional state the price alert definitions should match. The values must be one of PriceAlertDefinitionState. The match is case insensitive.

info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values Price Alerts API

description.content:
The AutoTrading service group provides endpoints for interacting with Saxo Bank's SaxoSelect offering.Through these interfaces a client application can get Saxo Select trade leaders, portfolios and investments. Portfolio investments can be created and modifed.
Note:
This service is subject to special licensing agreements and not generally available to all OpenAPI applications.
